assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the three REVIEWED references curated on one-punch-man:bang@manga at basis_commit: the canonical OPM character model readiness index, hero character-state ledger and relationship state ledger, read for every Bang entry, their stated readiness rules and their evidence conventions, as repository analysis of the Japanese tankobon V01-V37. Each ledger's official-web 235-287 overlay is active_provisional and excluded from the discovery coverage; it was read but no claim here rests on it. The frozen volume deep readings, the Japanese dialogue and register audits, the checkpoints and the source media are not curated on this subject; nothing is borrowed from them, the chapter/image locators were not rechecked, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: From the V04 baseline (the City Z meteor summons) through the V37 collected state: the V06 dojo history, the V10-V11 Garou lineage and search with Bomb, the V16-V19 confrontations and institutional exclusion, the V30 private history, reform and teacher-failure admission, the V31-V33 bodily failure and refused reclamation, and the V34 restitution proposal, apology burden, sparring and retirement. No state after V37 is assessed, and no default state is designated.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The ledgers record a consistent motive set across many volumes: ego-light recognition of superior capability (V06, Saitama many times stronger), loneliness after losing students (V08 lobster invitation), nondelegable responsibility for Garou (V19 ワシはワシの責任を果たすため), and at V30 a youthful selfish ideology reformed over years after defeat by Bomb, with an admitted neglect as teacher. These are per-volume state deltas, not an integrated thesis with rival readings or conditional decision rules for Bang. The project's own strong label measures evidence breadth and is not adopted; C would need a specialist interpretation that holds the motives together.

Transitions are dated and located: V04 emerging baseline, V06 moderate, V08 loneliness channel, V10-V11 former master and Bomb pairing, V16-V17 personal confrontation and final-stand readiness, V19 exclusion and owned responsibility, V30 moderate to strong with private history (151/0034-0036, 153/0075-0086, 155/0137-0159), V31-V33 fall and refused reclamation, V34 restitution and retirement (174-175/0183, 0198-0213). The ledgers keep planned reform distinct from completed success. Phases are narrative boundaries rather than selectable states with exclusions, so B is not supported.

Only a few forms are recorded: the elderly-masculine ワシ, おぬし and ～のう register and 心に乱れが見える (V04), ワシはワシの責任を果たすため 行かせてもらうぜ (V19), and at V30 a youthful 俺 ideology against an elder teaching register and a changed お兄ちゃん to Bomb. The register audits that would support a fuller inventory are not curated on this subject. Enough for bounded canon questions about register shifts, not a voice reference.

Located ordinary conduct: the lobster invitation to Saitama and Genos with the depopulated dojo, Charanko left to prepare the meal and kept despite low ability, recruitment of Saitama, advice-seeking from Kuseno about raising disciples and the hotpot table, and the V34 attempt at ordinary conversation with Garou. A recurring channel, but sampled in a handful of scenes between crises.

The relationship ledger records directional, recipient-specific entries: calm senior advice to Genos without command, curiosity and respect toward Saitama, plain dealing with Charanko, coordinated martial and family partnership with Bomb (younger mockery turning to an earnest request to watch), former-master responsibility toward Garou (invitation unaccepted, reclamation refused, later sparring and awkward talk), Atomic Samurai's retracted judgment, thanks to Child Emperor, and warm 大将 toward Fubuki. Differentiated and located; no rule predicts conduct toward an unfamiliar counterpart.

Interior access is thin and kept attributed: tears in the Child Emperor exchange support emotion but not a confession, the V34 wish that Garou find a purpose is recorded as his modal thought, and heart-in-fists language is explicitly not telepathy. Behavior carries the evidence.

The richest dimension: catastrophe response and persistence against Melzargard with a fast tactical update, stopping the Tatsumaki and Genos escalation, punitive but name-addressing confrontation of Garou over Charanko, combined technique against Elder Centipede and a final stand under expected defeat, protective redirection of Tanktop Master, protective art instead of old means at V30, and interposition at lethal proximity. The ledgers record failure (the facial blow and fall) and say purpose does not guarantee victory.

Ethical choices are located: S-class responsibility framed against Tatsumaki, owned responsibility under institutional suspicion, reform from selfish violence, a nonlethal protective art, confessed role failure, and the V34 proposal to help many times more people than were harmed together with accepted bowing and apology. The ledgers record outcomes and stated positions, not a deliberative process, and say restitution and reform remain uncompleted.
Apart from the recorded younger mockery of Bomb at V30, the curated evidence establishes no play repertoire. This is a gap in the evidence, not evidence that Bang lacks humor.

The ledgers cover V01-V37 with per-volume entries propagated after frozen readings and Japanese register audits, and chapter/archive-image locators with availability boundaries. Bang's evidence is distributed across three shared ledgers rather than a dedicated document, the web overlay is provisional and outside coverage, and the readings and audits behind the entries are not curated here.

Affirmative limits are located: the brothers' combined technique cannot defeat Elder Centipede (V17), bodily-age limits, the fall after a facial blow, the unaccepted V30 invitation, Garou's explicit refusal of present reclamation, an admitted teacher failure, the unfulfilled promise to subdue Garou at V28, and at V34 a retirement and reform that are planned, not completed. Child Emperor's exclusion is kept as his model, not proof that Bang would compromise the raid.

Every delta carries its volume boundary, chapter/image locator and an available-from marker, and the index says dated sections keep their original boundaries. This fixes knowledge order and periods well; no cutoff-indexed state selector with exclusions is supplied, so B is not supported.

scenario_readiness.note: A handful of recorded forms and register labels do not support generated dialogue; lines beyond them would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Bang's speech.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any V04-V37 state the ledgers describe; the refusal is strongest after V30 and V34, where reconciliation, retirement and registration are explicitly open.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Any counterpart, including Garou, Bomb, Charanko, Saitama and Genos as the ledgers describe them; the refusal does not depend on the partner.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts beyond the located V04-V37 episodes
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than bounded canon description

scenario_readiness.note: The ledgers supply state deltas and limits but no conditional rule set or default state, and the readiness index records no specialist-ready promotion. A novel context would require inventing the operational model.
Ordinary dojo, hospitality and teaching scenes answer bounded canon questions, but they are few and supply no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary scene.
Ethical positions and outcomes are located, but the ledgers give no deliberative process and leave restitution, reform and reconciliation unresolved.
No romantic relation appears in the curated evidence. Nothing is established either way.

Hero work, crisis coordination and dojo teaching are well represented, including the V30 conflict between them and the V34 retirement, but as located episodes rather than a policy for novel professional situations.

known_limits.statement: The readiness index defines readiness as conditional evidence breadth, not importance or power, and records no specialist-ready promotion; Bang's strong label from V30 is a project routing tier, not a reconstruction capability.

At V37 the ledgers leave the V30 invitation unaccepted and present reclamation refused, and treat the V34 retirement, Garou's restitution and future registration as planned or modal rather than completed.
Child Emperor's exclusion of Bang, Bang's diagnosis of Garou's alteration and the heart-in-fists language are attributed models or claims, not established facts about Bang's conduct or Garou's state.
The web 235-287 overlay (teacherly observation of Garou and Suiryu) is active_provisional and outside the discovery coverage; no claim here extends past V37.
No dedicated Bang model, voice inventory or conditional decision rules are in the curated evidence; the assessment rests on entries distributed through shared ledgers.

The frozen deep readings, the Japanese dialogue and register audits and the checkpoints are not curated on this subject, so the locators were not rechecked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
